conclusion: Carrier of one copy of the SIRT6 rs117385980 T allele. Two small candidate-gene studies both report this allele is under-represented among the longest-lived, but neither reached statistical significance and the more recent study found no association with frailty. Exploratory only; not predictive of individual lifespan.

The common SIRT6 rs117385980 genotype, carried by about 96% of gnomAD samples. The exploratory under-representation reported for the minor allele does not apply here. No lifespan association has been demonstrated for this genotype; its apparent advantage is only the comparison baseline.

Homozygous for the SIRT6 rs117385980 minor allele. Neither cited study observed a single homozygote (8 heterozygotes among 227 Iranian adults; 12 among 198 Finnish men), so this module's evidence base says nothing about this genotype. gnomAD does record homozygotes, so the genotype is real; no inference is offered here.
